title: Kimi Structured Output → Fireworks
description: A product review sentiment classifier using Kimi's JSON mode to return structured analysis. Tests JSON schema adherence and field completeness on Fireworks models.

messages.content: Classify the sentiment of product reviews. Return JSON with exactly these fields and no others: sentiment (must be one of: positive, negative, neutral), confidence (float between 0 and 1), key_phrases (array of strings).
The battery life is incredible but the screen could be brighter. Overall I'm happy with the purchase.
